name: Mend Mastery I
description: Mend now rolls 2d12 and keeps the highest roll. The supervising leaf improves Mend's healing to 7 HP for Weak, 10 HP for Gentle, 12 HP for Strong, and 18 HP for Perfect per trigger.
flavor: The supervising leaf arrives carrying what appears to be a tiny clipboard. Nobody knows where it got one. The Fae medical team immediately becomes significantly more organized.
The supervising leaf inspects your injuries, turns toward the other leaves, and begins furiously pointing. Somehow, healing efficiency improves immediately.
The supervising leaf has arrived. Several other leaves immediately stand up straighter. You didn't know leaves could do that.
The supervising leaf gives your injuries a long, disappointed look before assigning the other leaves to their positions. Apparently this is a coordinated operation now.
One leaf attempts to begin healing early. The supervising leaf gently pushes it back into formation. There are procedures now.
The supervising leaf produces a tiny clipboard and begins taking notes. You are becoming increasingly concerned about where it keeps getting office supplies.
